input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: A full sweep of the Agreement (Articles 1-10, including the Warranties article at p0055-p0058, the Confidentiality article at p0047-p0054 and the General Provisions at p0059-p0070) surfaces no limitation of liability, no aggregate cap, no exclusive remedy and no exclusion of indirect or consequential damages; the only uses of "liability" are the no-joint-venture disclaimers in Section 10.2. Both Parties are therefore exposed to uncapped liability, which fails the fallback (mutual cap of 12 months' fees with carve-outs). We insert the shortest fallback-level clause as new Section 10.9: a mutual aggregate cap tied to the fees paid or payable by the Company in the twelve months preceding the claim, with confidentiality obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence and willful misconduct expressly uncapped. We have not volunteered the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual consequential-damages waiver, data protection/security, fraud, IP-infringement carve-outs or the payment-obligations exclusion, which remain available if HDI will engage on the preferred position.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

ops.text: 10.9 Limitation of Liability. Except for a Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations, its indemnification obligations, and its gross negligence or willful misconduct, for which no limitation shall apply, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no limitation of liability, so we have added our fallback position: a mutual cap of twelve months' fees, with each Party's confidentiality and indemnification obligations, gross negligence and willful misconduct sitting outside the cap.
proposal.summary: Insert a mutual 12-months'-fees liability cap with carve-outs for confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence and willful misconduct
